a mobile agent infrastructure for user privacy protection is feasible.

we have developed an infrastructure for user tracking prevention and privacy protection in Internet shopping that is based on a new infrastructure consisting of a mobile agents base station and a Cardinality Observer.

the cardinality observer is able to decrease the probability of linking the customer's order with the information gathered about the user by the vendor, that this probability is decreased by a factor that is linear in the cardinality of the profile space, and that the mobile agent base stations is able to deterministically guarantee a desired linking probability.

a new infrastructure for privacy protection and user tracking prevention in Internet shopping.
privacy protection for customers in Internet shopping.

the proposed solution provides a new infrastructure that is capable of preventing vendors from directly linking information about customers with identifying information contained in their orders.

our new infrastructure allows customers to protect their privacy by controlling the probability with which the vendor can link information gathered about the user with the user's real identity.

the new infrastructure allows the user to control how much privacy is sacrificed in exchange for convenience.
